name: cavemio-selection-actions
title: Selection actions
description: Select text and a pill appears under it. Pick an action or describe an edit, and the rewrite streams in place.

cavemio.accessibility:
- role="toolbar" with labelled buttons; arrow keys move between them. Progress, the finished rewrite and failures are announced.
- Escape steps back: it stops a rewrite (keeping what streamed for review), discards a result, or closes the pill.
- Clicking the pill keeps the text selected, and the CSS Custom Highlight API keeps it marked while you type (the ::highlight(ui-selection) rule is added for you).
- Stop and Discard abort the request through the signal, so the model stops generating too.
- With reduced motion, the glide, folds and width morph are instant.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: value / onValueChange
props.description: – · The text, rendered with its line breaks. Keep calls onValueChange with the rewrite in place.

props.name: actions
props.description: – · Always visible. pendingLabel is shown while it runs, e.g. "Shortening".

props.name: more
props.description: – · Behind the chevron. Without them there is no chevron.

props.name: onAction
props.description: – · Gets id ("custom" for typed edits), text, instruction, before, after and an AbortSignal. Return chunks to stream, nothing for actions handled elsewhere, or throw to show Try again.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: "Describe edits" · The instruction field’s placeholder and label.

useCases.title: AI writing editors
useCases.description: Select a sentence and choose Improve or Shorten.

useCases.title: Notes and docs apps
useCases.description: Rewrite part of a note without opening a chat.

useCases.title: Email and message composers
useCases.description: Fix the tone of one paragraph in a draft.

useCases.title: CMS and content tools
useCases.description: Let editors ask for a change to the exact words they selected.

features.title: A pill under the selection
features.description: It attaches under the last selected line, centred on the selection.

features.title: Quick actions and your own words
features.description: Your most-used actions sit in the pill, more are behind the chevron, and a field takes a custom instruction.

features.title: The rewrite streams in place
features.description: The new text replaces the selection word by word, and the pill follows its last line.

features.title: Keep or discard
features.description: When it finishes, Keep is focused so Enter accepts. Discard and try again are beside it.

features.title: Stop at any time
features.description: Escape stops a rewrite, and the request is aborted so the model stops generating too.

features.title: The original is safe
features.description: If it fails, the original text is untouched and the pill offers Try again.

states.title: open
states.description: Under the selection’s last line: "Describe edits", your actions, and the chevron for more.

states.title: expanded
states.description: The field folds away and the extra actions slide in; the chevron turns.

states.title: typing
states.description: The actions fold away, the field grows into their space and a send button appears.

states.title: thinking
states.description: The selection dims slightly; a spinner and "Improving…" shimmer until the first words arrive.

states.title: streaming
states.description: The rewrite replaces the selection word by word; the pill follows its last line.

states.title: result
states.description: The pill eases to its new width as Keep (focused, so Enter accepts), Discard and try again blur in.

states.title: error
states.description: "That didn’t work" with Try again; the original text is untouched.
